The *Aññamaññapaccayakathā* (Kv 15.2) is a debate section located within the fifteenth chapter (*pannarasama vagga*) of the *Kathāvatthu*, the fifth treatise of the Theravāda Abhidhamma Piṭaka [SuttaCentral]. The title concerns the reciprocal or mutuality condition (*aññamaññapaccaya*), addressing doctrinal controversies surrounding causal conditionality and dependent origination [SuttaCentral; DharmaNexus]. SuttaCentral records one modern translation of the text [SuttaCentral].
